judged_text: update feeds `EmbeddableHost.where(id: params[:id]).first` — nil for a nonexistent id — straight into save_host, which executes `host.host = ...` on nil and raises NoMethodError. Saving an edit against a host another admin has just deleted (stale list) returns a 500 instead of a 404, showing the admin a server-error popup with no recovery path.

adjudication.rationale: In `Admin::EmbeddableHostsController#update`, the code does `host = EmbeddableHost.where(id: params[:id]).first` and then unconditionally calls `save_host(host)`. `save_host` immediately dereferences `host` (`host.host = ...`, `host.category_id = ...`), so if the record doesn’t exist (e.g., stale UI editing a host that was deleted), `host` will be `nil` and this will raise `NoMethodError`, producing a 500 instead of a 404/handled error.
